Needs deterministic quota planning (reserved GPU count + burst) and explicit throughput guarantees tied to ARR. Model preferences: open-models quantized (Llama3-70B quantized or MPT-30B-8bit) with optional vendor-backed models for critical pipelines. Compliance: VPC-only control plane, KMS/HSM key ownership, audit logs retained 3 years, EU data residency for EU customer traffic.
